notes.subject: ⟨ sebaka ⟩
notes.rationale: Seheberu se re feela 'O ile wa fetola sebopeho pele ho yona' — 'sebaka' se ekeditswe ho hlalosa

notes.subject: פנית
notes.rationale: 'O ile wa fetola sebopeho' e bolela 'wa hloekisa, wa bula tsela' (KJV 'preparedst room') kgahlanong le YLT 'wa shebisa' — pono ya 'ho hloekisa' e kgethilwe

notes.subject: ותשרש / שרשיה
notes.rationale: Tiriso ya motso o mošošoani ka hara lentsoe le le leng — ho hlahlama ka metla; se amohelwa ka dikarolo tse pedi ka Sesotho

translation: O kondositse ⟨ sebaka ⟩ pele ho yona, mme ya hlahlama ka metla, ya tlatsa lefatshe.
